practice.input: See a warehouse shipment held before loading and hear one complete four-person Korean team exchange.
practice.output: Mediate between shipment accuracy and deadline pressure; distinguish verified facts from provisional estimates and agree on the next communication.
practice.dings: One start cue and one end cue around the finished card

card.title: Before the Shipment Leaves
card.situation: A shipment's pallet label does not match the observed box count. Warehouse, quality control, client liaison, and team lead decide how to verify it without making an ungrounded delivery promise.
card.description: Handle a discrepancy, qualify what is known, and give the client a truthful next update.
card.scene: Warehouse loading area with one labeled pallet, a held cart, a checklist, and four colleagues discussing before anything is loaded.
card.learnerInput: An observable label-versus-box-count discrepancy; ten concise professional Korean turns from four distinct roles, with cross-speaker qualifications and a mediated plan.
card.expectedOutput: Explain that departure is on hold pending a factual check, assign verification, and tell the client only what is currently confirmed.
card.relationshipAndRegister: Four workplace colleagues; professional but spoken 해요체/합니다체 as appropriate to role, without ceremonial or test-style phrasing.
card.targetConstruction: Separate observed facts from inference, respectfully interrupt pressure to promise a deadline, then negotiate a conditional handoff and update.
card.retainedCore: Each turn advances the same pallet discrepancy and shipment decision; no generic logistics exposition.
card.variationOpportunity: Change the discrepancy from the label's box count to a wrong destination code and formulate a truthful client update while the correction is checked.
card.independentProductionPrompt: Without seeing the model, tell the team that a destination code is inconsistent, keep loading paused, and propose what to tell the client without claiming a confirmed arrival time.

speakerRoles.voiceCharacter: Decisive and measured; mediates accuracy against schedule pressure
Concrete, observant, and ready to hold the load
Precise, calm, and careful about which count is verified
speakerRoles.castingNote: Distinct Standard Korean female voice selected from the connected ElevenLabs library on 2026-10-27; not the team lead's Leejin voice.

speakerRoles.voiceCharacter: Aware of client expectations but willing to correct an over-promise
speakerRoles.castingNote: Distinct Standard Korean male voice selected from the connected ElevenLabs library on 2026-10-27; not the warehouse worker's Min-joon voice.

lines.speaker: jihye
lines.ko: 오늘 출하 건, 1차 검수는 끝났는데 라벨 수량이 실물과 안 맞는다고 들었어요. 어디까지 확인됐죠?
lines.en: I heard the label count doesn't match the actual shipment, even though the first inspection is done. What have we confirmed so far?

lines.speaker: minseok
lines.ko: 한 팔레트가 열 상자인데 라벨에는 열두 상자로 적혀 있습니다. 아직 차에는 싣지 않았고요.
lines.en: There are ten boxes on one pallet, but its label says twelve. We haven't loaded it onto the truck yet.

lines.speaker: haeun
lines.ko: 검수표상 제품 수량은 맞아요. 라벨만 잘못된 건지 출고 목록도 틀린 건지 대조 중입니다.
lines.en: The product count matches the inspection sheet. We're checking whether only the label is wrong or the release list is wrong too.

lines.speaker: junho
lines.ko: 거래처에는 오후 도착 예정이라고 했어요. 지연 가능성부터 알릴까요, 아니면 확인될 때까지 기다릴까요?
lines.en: I told the client to expect delivery this afternoon. Should I flag a possible delay now, or wait for the check?

lines.speaker: jihye
lines.ko: 확인 전엔 수량도 도착 시간도 확답하지 말죠. 대신 지금 확인 중인 내용과 다음 연락 시간을 분명히 전해 주세요.
lines.en: Let's not confirm the count or arrival time before the check. Instead, clearly tell them what we're checking and when we'll contact them next.

lines.speaker: haeun
lines.ko: 제가 목록과 실물을 다시 대조할게요. 차이가 없으면 수정 라벨 확인까지 마치겠습니다.
lines.en: I'll compare the list with the physical goods again. If they match, I'll also verify the corrected label.

lines.speaker: minseok
lines.ko: 그동안 상자는 적재하지 않고 따로 두겠습니다. 라벨도 승인받은 뒤에 바꿀게요.
lines.en: I'll keep the boxes aside and won't load them in the meantime. I'll change the label only after it's approved.

lines.speaker: jihye
lines.ko: 좋아요. 다만 수정 사실만 남기면 나중에 헷갈릴 수 있으니, 원인과 확인한 사람도 기록해 주세요.
lines.en: Good. But simply noting that it was corrected could cause confusion later, so record the cause and who verified it as well.

lines.speaker: haeun
lines.ko: 네. 차이가 계속 나면 출하 보류 사유를 함께 적어 공유하겠습니다.
lines.en: Of course. If the discrepancy remains, I'll document and share why the shipment is being held.

lines.speaker: junho
lines.ko: 그럼 거래처에는 출하 전 수량 확인 중이라고만 알리고, 확인 결과가 나오는 대로 도착 시간을 다시 안내하겠습니다.
lines.en: Then I'll tell the client we're verifying the count before dispatch, and give them an updated arrival time once we have the result.

variationPrompt.en: The destination code, not the box count, is inconsistent. Keep loading paused and propose an accurate client update without promising arrival time.
variationPrompt.ko: 이번엔 상자 수가 아니라 배송지 코드가 맞지 않아요. 적재를 멈춘 채 확인을 맡기고, 도착 시간을 단정하지 않는 거래처 안내를 제안해 보세요.
variationPrompt.sampleAnswerHidden: 배송지 코드가 서로 달라서 적재를 잠시 멈추겠습니다. 정확한 배송지를 확인 중이라고 먼저 안내하고, 확인되는 대로 예상 도착 시간을 다시 알려드리죠.

card.artworkBrief: Realistic Korean warehouse loading zone. Four colleagues—female team lead, male warehouse worker, female quality checker, male client liaison—inspect one pallet with a mismatched box-count tag before loading. Visible checklist and hand cart; no legible writing, brand names, or logos.
